steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Texas!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Miss Caterina... I mean, Giovanna, might be in danger!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: What did you say?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I just called her, and have a really uneasy feeling.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Lappland.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Yo.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: What do you want?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I just wanted to give you an update on your old friend. She's somewhere near your little hideout, surrounded by wise guys from her own famiglia.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Texas, we should go help her!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...I know.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Just a sec.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Are you seriously going?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You were all ready to make an enemy of the Rossatis to get out of here.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: But now you're going to stay in the swamp just for her?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Think, Texas.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: This is your best chance to turn around and walk away from it all.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Sora...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You know, Texas?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: This was supposed to be a little job I picked up as a way to go looking for you.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But, I soon came to realize that I'd fallen in love with Siracusa's performing arts scene.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: People here have a certain arrogance to them, but they're much better than the materialistic Lungmenite businessmen.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: And Exusiai won't stop raving about how she's going to find the best pizza in Siracusa.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: As for Croissant... She's always been easygoing.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I just wanted to catch up with you. Maybe we can go back to Lungmen after everyone's had enough fun here.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: We'll go back to Lungmen eventually. The four of us, together.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: That's right, the four of us, together.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Well, actually, I just had a chat with Miss Giovanna and asked her to take a tour of Lungmen with us. So that'd make five.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...Okay.
A number of people have collapsed in an alley.
A number of wounds have appeared across Giovanna's body.
Everyone, including herself, knows there is no escape for her.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Give it up, Giovanna.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Got anything to drink, Wallach?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Go grab a bottle from the car.

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Yessir.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: I've thought about it before. If we would've been better off getting into certain businesses back in Columbia.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Originium weapons, designer drugs, military channels...

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: I've also thought about... if there were certain opportunities that I should've seized.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Getting on good terms with those officials, or even extending an olive branch to the Columbian government.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: But in the end, I decided that some things had to be done in moderation.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: We're too deeply invested, we're holding too much. I won't claim to be a good person, but at least we can't forget that there are some things we can't do.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: You could call it principle, or you could call it stubbornness.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Times have changed, Giovanna.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: A new era calls for new norms.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: The so-called 'morality and justice' of the old guard should be cast aside.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Even if we don't do it, someone eventually will. And when that time comes, we'll be the ones who get pushed out.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Or you think sitting around, watching Columbia's other famiglie get their mitts on these things is the right way to do it?

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: What would you do in my position, Wallach?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: I'll control it all, new and old. Everything will be at my disposal.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: We're not taking the world back to the old ways, we're turning away from them.

steps.name: Rossati Mafioso
steps.text: Got the booze, Wallach.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Come on. Have one last drink with me.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Fine.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: This one's my favorite. You've been waiting a long time for this, haven't you?

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: It was supposed to celebrate your return.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Well, how about that. From here on, you're Don Rossati.

steps.name: Wallach
steps.text: Giovanna.

steps.name: Giovanna
steps.text: Do it.
The sound of sharp metal slicing through flesh appears in the alley.
It is quickly drowned out by the sound of the falling rain.
Texas knows she is already too late.
The alley is scarred by traces of battle, and blood spreads out across the ground.
Her gaze goes to the source of the bloody water, where a familiar figure lies fallen.
Her heart quivers.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Giovanna!

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: We should be able to have a nice discussion over here, Your Honor.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I won't become your accomplice.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Accomplice? That's a rather extreme choice of words.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Shouldn't you be thanking me for saving your life?

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Forget it, just treat it as an act of kindness on my part.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: The upside about you young folks is that you're go-getters. The downside is you tend to overdo it.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: There's nothing I particularly need you to do for me, actually.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: I just don't want to see an outstanding young woman like you fall.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: You? Really?

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: I think the Carracci incident has given you some misconceptions about me.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: No, I don't think it has.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: I happen to care more about what's in front of me, that's all.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: 'The government is just the cloth draped over Grey Hall's round table.'

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Lavinia, everyone in Siracusa knows of Signora Sicilia's lament.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: But I'd imagine there are few who understand the source of this lament.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Thirty years ago, there was a group of youths like you who naively believed they could free Siracusa from the famiglie.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: But there was no end to the dark clouds that hung over the country, and they couldn't conjure up any support.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: So they chose to try to win over a number of famiglie by catering to their interests, trying to fight... the thing they thought they could resist.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: As for what happened to them... nobody knows.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Nobody knows?

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Try to picture this scenario, Signorina Lavinia.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Your father is a clerk who works for the city government.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: One day, you get up, shower, and have breakfast as usual. That's when you realize your father forgot something at home, and your mother asks you to bring it to him.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: It's the rainy season, and you're in a bad mood because you had an argument with your father. But then you think to yourself, it's partially your fault, and it would be better to just apologize.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: But when you walk into city hall, you feel an unnatural stillness.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: The place shouldn't be so quiet at this time of day.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Soon, you see blood seeping from beneath the doors of various offices.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: And that's when you realize that streaks of blood are painted all across the floor.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: You find that everyone in city hall has gone missing.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: What scares you even more is that not a single soul will comment on it, no matter who you ask. Even your own mother is completely silent.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: It's as if the disappeared never existed in the first place.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: After a while, people begin to appear at city hall again, and a bit after that, the normal hustle and bustle returns.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: And you finally realize, that's all there is to it.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: That's when Signora Sicilia's saying really starts to spread.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: 'The government is just the cloth draped over Grey Hall's round table.' And naturally, the tablecloth can be changed at will.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: When you've lived through it, you'll understand—

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Anger. Of course the anger is there. But what happens after the anger passes?

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: After anger, comes nothing.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Just as you are now, not knowing who you can even vent your grievance to.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: To Don Bernardo? To Famiglia Bellone? Or to Signora Sicilia?

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: No, of course not. They are all cogs in the existing machine, and you, as the gatekeeper to this machine, know better than anyone else—

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: It can't be shaken.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: And that's why you want to tell me... that all I can do is to cover my eyes and ears like you, pretending to be oblivious to everything that's going on.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: Pretending I'm living a semblance of what you could call a life.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Signorina Lavinia, you are even more naive than my daughter.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: And as someone who's experienced it all, my advice to you is the same as the last time you came to me—no matter what your ideals are, you must first live on.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: And if you're really in that much of a hurry to die, at least find a successor first.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Sometimes, living to pass down your ideals can be even more difficult than dying a merciful death.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: Oh right, I'll be taking up my new post in a few days, and Don Bernardo has arranged a speech for me to deliver to the whole city.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: There's nothing I need you to do for me, but if you'd like, you are welcome to keep my wife and daughter company.

steps.name: Rubio
steps.text: I do believe that isn't anything that would violate your principles.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Hmm? You're not going with the rest of your friends, my child?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Uhh... I have a somewhat personal question I'd like to ask you.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Please continue.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I learned a few things about you back when I was in school. Back then, both you and His Holiness the Pope were seen as promising young talents.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: But after Signora Sicilia visited Laterano, you left with her. Didn't even hesitate.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: You want to know why I left Laterano with Sicilia?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Not exactly. What I'd like to know is, you must get along very well with Signora Sicilia, right?

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: That depends on what you mean by 'get along.' But if you mean in terms of understanding, it may be the case that nobody understands her as well as I do.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: However, our personalities are actually quite incompatible.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: At least these days, I am happier hiding in this city to avoid the headaches she brings me.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Isn't that also part of getting along with someone?

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: That, I cannot deny.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Then, how were you able to stay on good terms with her for decades?

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Hahahaha!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Senior Agenir, I'm serious!

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: An excellent question indeed, my child.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: You certainly ask much more interesting questions than your friend.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: But first, there's something I'm curious about.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: From the description you just gave me, you seem to get along very well with Texas.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: That's right, we're the best partners out there~

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: You don't doubt your friendship at all.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Not even a little.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: In that case— Ah, I see now. The reason behind your question.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Shared empathy allows you to treat people without reservation, but you still have doubts about the process of getting along with those who lack that empathy.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Moreover, it is not deception that you fear, but this doubt itself.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: You are ashamed of this doubt when you are reciprocated with nothing but sincerity.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: But at the same time, you are also afraid of how you will handle yourself if these doubts prove to be true one day.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Is that the case?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Um, yeah, that's exactly what I was thinking!

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: I think every Sankta who leaves Laterano will encounter this problem.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: When Sicilia came to visit Laterano, I was tasked with serving as her guide.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: However, I did not leave Laterano with her because I was persuaded by her ideals, as the rumors claim.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Sicilia was still young at the time, and no matter how talented she was, it was impossible for her to instantly come up with a way to change Siracusa after but a brief stay in Laterano.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Her ideals were puerile and unrealistic, but they happened to resonate with some of my own thoughts at the time.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: We discussed and argued our ideas day and night until finally, I decided to go with her to Siracusa to settle them.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Discussing, and arguing...

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Even after coming to Siracusa, we never settled the arguments between us. As a matter of fact, our views on Siracusa have never quite lined up.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: But this does not prevent us from understanding what the other is thinking.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: So, the key is discussing and arguing?

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Haha, what do you think?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I don't think that's right.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I don't think Texas and I ever had any serious discussions about anything. I'm not even sure when it happened, but we somehow became really good partners.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: You're a perceptive one, my child.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: In the end, what kept me bound to Sicilia was not ideals, convenience, or even emotions.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: But time.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Time?

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: The passage of time will bridge most gaps and bind people together, regardless of what they think about it.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: You'll always be good partners, won't you?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Of course. Always and forever.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Then, all you need to do is keep moving forward.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: You will experience many different things, as will she.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Perhaps your stories will individually have very little in common.

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: But as long as your lives intertwine at some point...

steps.name: Agenir
steps.text: Well, you'll have nothing to worry about.
